# @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit

> Backend-only TypeScript library (Node.js >= 20) for MGPL Diagnostics patient invoices. It handles tests, packages, services, consumables and medicines with qty/rate/discount/GST/HSN, a bill discount shared before tax, round-off, split payments, PAID/PARTIALLY PAID/DUE status and amount in words (Indian). Arithmetic is done in integer paise. Invoices render as PDF (react-pdf) or HTML on the report-kit letterhead. It also provides `createMgplApi()`, one HTTP handler for reports AND invoices, with a Fastify plugin. Peer dependency: @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit.

Key facts for agents:
- Mount: `createMgplApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" })`; Fastify `mgplFastify` from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify"; Express via report-kit's `toNodeHandler`.
- Routes: POST /invoice (format pdf|html|json), GET /price-list, GET /invoice-samples (opt-in), plus every report-kit route.
- In code: `buildInvoice({ invoiceNo, patient, items: ["cbc", { code: "syringe-5ml", qty: 2 }], discount, payments })`, then `computeInvoice()` / `renderInvoicePdf()`.
- PRICE_LIST rates are SAMPLE placeholders. Currency is written "Rs." (the font has no rupee glyph). Amount column = qty × rate − line discount.
- Run `npm run smoke` (maths, fit, glyphs, PDF text) and `npm run test:api` (HTTP + client + Fastify + node:http) after changes.
